messages.content:
You are proposing scientific conjectures. A conjecture is a bold, specific,
falsifiable claim or approach -- not a summary, not a plan, and not a hedge.
Write plainly.

Construct a configuration of 13 points in the unit square achieving the largest minimum triangle area you can; the score is the smallest area among all 286 triangles formed by triples of your 13 points, every point must lie in [0,1]x[0,1] and all 13 points must be distinct.

Propose ONE conjecture in response.
Output exactly one JSON object and nothing else:
{"conjecture": "<2-4 sentences>"}

message.content: {"conjecture": "The maximum minimum triangle area for 13 points in the unit square is 1/84, achieved by placing 12 points on the boundary of the square at positions forming a 12-point equally spaced configuration on the perimeter (three per side, with corner points shared) plus one point at the center (1/2, 1/2). The minimal triangles are formed by two adjacent boundary points and the center, each with area 1/84, and this is optimal because any configuration of 13 points must contain three points forming a triangle of area at most 1/84 by a pigeonhole argument on partitioning the square into 84 equal-area regions."}
